newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada board okays IPL line reactivation.
newsitem.headline: Canada board okays IPL line reactivation.

text.p: Canada's National Energy Board said on Thursday it approved Interprovincial Pipe Lines' application to reactivate an oil products pipeline in Ontario.
The NEB said the approval covered the reactivation of the first 210 km (130 miles) of IPL's Line 8 to Milgrove Junction, north of Hamilton, Ontario, from Sarnia Terminal.
Line 8 is part of IPL's older system operations and was in service until the fall of 1994. It was formally deactivated in late 1995.
The reactivation project was intended to increase system efficiency by using otherwise deactivated facilities, the NEB said.
The decision followed a public hearing held in London, Ontario in late January.
Interprovincial is a unit of IPL Energy Inc.
